page.notes: Top title is partly damaged by stains; the words "REVM", "in praeced", "memora" are cut at the right edge and read as far as visible. Several index words are uncertain due to blotting and show-through; the Greek-like abbreviations are copied as seen. The right half of the page is cut off and not transcribed. The upper part of the page, with the head of the title and the start of the index, is cut off; the running head "VERBO" is only partly visible. Some numbers and letters are doubtful in the scan: "acone.aconitum" and "achaina cerus" may be misprinted. Page number is not clearly printed and is given with [?] status only in the sense that it is uncertain.
